_comment: Qwen3.5-4B arm. Mirrors corpus-boros-mirror-q34b-sysreminders.json exactly except for the model: same deck, same seats, same prompt, same toolset, so the two are a clean model comparison. 3.5 was chosen 2026-08-17 for its 262,144-position context against Qwen3-4B's 40,960. NOTE the parser differs -- 3.5 emits qwen3_xml where the 3 family emits hermes; loop.sh:62 sets it and serve_policy.sh takes MTG_TOOL_PARSER. A wrong parser makes every call fail while games complete and look normal. UNMEASURED: 3.5 narrated at median 89 completion tokens vs the 8B's 20 pre-SFT, which made its rollout 1.9x slower. Measure completion tokens per decision before trusting a rollout budget.
